residuals_judged.my_view: Accurate description: the material is pinned by sha256 of the copied bytes (recorded in-manifest and in EVIDENCE.md), not to a git blob, so it cannot be re-fetched/re-verified against a commit. For THIS docket it barely matters: it is not promotion-eligible, and the reproduced bytes plus recorded sha256 make it self-verifying in place. It would matter the moment such a docket were ever treated as publication evidence, or if the copied bytes were lost.

residuals_judged.residual: file-fact standing gap -- a mechanically verified fact can only render EXTENDS
residuals_judged.my_view: C-curated kind='file-fact' confirmed. ACCEPTABLE CONSERVATISM, not a correctness problem: EXTENDS understates, so no false verification is asserted -- the failure mode this whole line of units exists to close (a non-model run asserting CONFIRMS) is not reopened. The real cost is information loss: in CLAIMS.md a mechanically verified fact is indistinguishable from a merely hand-asserted extension except through the free-text reason. A typed standing would buy precision and machine-checkability; it would cost a schema/vocab change across manifest/materialize/assemble/assess plus tests and migration, and -- the important risk -- any new standing that carries CONFIRMS-like authority must be grantable ONLY by a mechanical checker, never by a caller, or it becomes the same defect in a new coat.
